notes: Tomb Raider I-III (Core Design's engine): level files are DATA/*.PHD for Tomb Raider I and data/*.TR2 for II and III, the formats TRX reads from the original data folder (https://github.com/LostArtefacts/TRX, https://opentomb.github.io/TRosettaStone3/trosettastone.html). One row: the three games share one engine lineage and TRX is one runtime for all of them. No enginehost plugin yet.
